tasks.label: wxKanban Kit — Install & Connect
tasks.detail: SCOPE-095: on folder open, run the one-shot bootstrap — install deps, register the hosted MCP with Claude Code (.mcp.json), start the gateway, and install the Dev Cockpit. init.mjs is idempotent (PID-guarded gateway, unchanged-.mcp.json short-circuit) so it is safe to run on every open, and it supersedes the standalone gateway-start / cockpit-install tasks so the gateway is never double-started on :3003.
